title: Homepage – Rochdale Borough Council
search_snippet: Rochdale Borough Council Fostering in the borough of Rochdale Fostering is a way of caring for other people's children and young people away from their family home. Take your first step to giving childhood a chance. You can chat with our friendly Fostering Team about the fostering process and ask any questions you might have. Find out more about fostering
